rules.statement: Naturschutz is supported only for arable and grassland areas, excluding alpine pasture.

conditions.expression: parcel.land_use in {arable, grassland} and not parcel.is_alpine_pasture

result.description: May be supported subject to all other rules.

rules.statement: The commitment runs to 31 December 2028 and lasts 6, 5 or 4 years for entry in 2023, 2024 or 2025 respectively.
At least one parcel must be managed under the measure in each participation year.

result.description: At least one compliant Naturschutz parcel.

rules.statement: A project confirmation issued by the competent provincial nature-conservation body is required and specifies mandatory parcel obligations.
Each enrolled parcel must comply with its project-confirmation obligations; amendments require prior consultation and written amendment of the confirmation.

result.description: All assigned Annex-I/project obligations must be met.

rules.statement: All Naturschutz parcels require use or care at least once every two years; grassland has at most three uses per year.

result.description: Biennial care and maximum use frequency.

rules.statement: Mechanical stone removal, terrain correction, deposits/fill, new drainage and silage-bale storage are prohibited.
Reseeding or overseeding of grassland is prohibited except remediation after specified damage/events with written provincial approval.

result.description: Written approval is needed for the exception.

rules.statement: No additional fertilisation on pasture other than mown pasture; sewage sludge and sewage-sludge compost are prohibited on all Naturschutz parcels.
Where an obligation requires grazing, maintain a current grazing diary with animal group, parcel, start/end of uninterrupted periods and animal-related interruptions; normally per parcel.
A project confirmation may only assign Annex-I Naturschutz codes; $ placeholders are concretised by the provincial authority in the confirmation.

result.description: Code is in the exhaustive Annex-I code table.

rules.statement: GL06, GL15 and GL25 require UBB or BIO plus the Naturschutz-Monitoring supplement 'Schnittzeit nach Phänologie'.
Great-bustard obligations TA and TB require UBB or BIO plus the monitoring supplement 'Beobachtung der Großtrappe'.
The land-use chapters S, A, B, G, W and O cannot be combined with each other; L is compatible with all listed chapters and H is incompatible with S only.
Annex-I arable fallow is supportable up to 25% of total farm arable area, but at least 2 ha.
The optional Regionaler Naturschutzplan requires an annual participation confirmation; it automatically continues if not deregistered and confirmation exists.
The regional plan supplement is EUR 270 per farm per year from 2024; where Naturschutz and Ergebnisorientierte Bewirtschaftung are both joined, pay it once only.
No other measure payment may combine on the individual Naturschutz parcel except Natura 2000/other protected areas and payment for landscape elements.
Apply NAT to request a parcel; payment also requires a Naturschutz reference area (graphic project confirmation) in INVEKOS-GIS.

result.description: NAT code and matching reference area.

rules.statement: Last entry into Naturschutz was 2025, requiring application by 31 December 2024; last Regionaler Naturschutzplan entry is 2028, requiring application by 31 December 2027.
Additional area is fully eligible in 2024-25; afterwards eligible expansion is capped at 50% of 2025 area, with 5 ha always allowed.
Annual area reduction is tolerated up to 5%, max 5 ha, and always 0.50 ha; exceedance triggers repayment for all differential area.

result.description: Use preceding-year measure area as 5% base.

rules.statement: Naturschutz (or Ergebnisorientierte Bewirtschaftung) has a payment ceiling of EUR 1,500/ha from 2024.
Farm payment is modulated: 100% to 200 ha, 90% for 200-300 ha, 85% for 300-1,000 ha and 75% above 1,000 ha.
In 2026, Naturschutz parcels with a fixed use date may be used from 12 August, whether first or second use; project confirmation remains unchanged and stated premium remains payable.

conditions.expression: year = 2026 and parcel.nat_code and parcel.has_fixed_use_date and use_date >= 2026-08-12

result.description: Use is permitted without confirmation amendment.
